architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.description: UI Checker is split into browser extension code, shared comparison logic, optional editor integration, and CI tooling.

ci.title: CI Runner
ci.description: The CI runner executes style checks outside the Chrome extension. It is useful for Storybook pages, component preview routes, and stable test pages.

design-tokens.title: Design Tokens
design-tokens.description: UI Checker can validate expected Figma values against imported design tokens.

figma-integration.title: Figma Integration
figma-integration.description: UI Checker talks directly to the Figma REST API from the extension service worker. No proxy server is required.

intro.title: UI Checker
intro.description: UI Checker is a Chrome DevTools extension for comparing live browser rendering against Figma design specs. It helps frontend teams catch styling drift in spacing, typography, color, sizing, borders, and component layout without relying on manual visual inspection.

vscode-bridge.title: VS Code Bridge
vscode-bridge.description: The VS Code bridge helps connect DevTools mismatches to source code.

workflows/compare-elements.title: Compare Elements
workflows/compare-elements.description: The primary UI Checker workflow runs inside Chrome DevTools.

workflows/visual-overlay.title: Visual Overlay
workflows/visual-overlay.description: The visual overlay workflow compares screenshots instead of only CSS declarations.
